les: Die onsigbare lyne om die aarde
kaps_punt: Lengte- en breedtegraad (grade): Breedtegraad en lengtegraad op 'n aardbol (grade)

items.bewering: Die aarde is 'n groot bal, en 'n aardbol is 'n klein model daarvan.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, encyclopedic entry 'Globe' (education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/globe): a globe is a three-dimensional scale model of Earth, spherical or ball-shaped. Mapping checked: the Earth is very nearly a sphere (slightly flattened at the poles), so 'bal' is a sound Grade 6 simplification; a learner reasoning further from it (lines round a ball, shorter circles near the top) is led to true conclusions in this lesson.

items.bewering: Hy is rond soos die aarde self en wys waar plekke regtig teenoor mekaar lê.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Globe': because a globe is spherical it represents surface features, directions and distances more accurately than a flat map.

items.bewering: Wys nou 'n plek in die middel van die see aan. Die water lyk oral dieselfde, en daar is niks om na te wys nie.
items.bron: Framing statement rather than a fact claim; consistent with University of Hawai'i 'Exploring Our Fluid Earth – Locating points on a globe' (manoa.hawaii.edu/exploringourfluidearth), which presents latitude and longitude as the way to locate any point exactly, including at sea.

items.bewering: Breedtegrade is die lyne wat van oos na wes om die bal loop.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': parallels of latitude form complete circles around the earth parallel to the equator; Humboldt State University GSP, 'Latitude and Longitude': parallels run east-west.

items.bewering: Hulle loop ewewydig met mekaar en raak nooit aan mekaar nie.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: Absolute claim ('nooit') checked as such. University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': parallels are parallel to the equator and to each other, so they never cross.

items.bewering: Die ewenaar is die breedtegraad om die middel van die aarde, en hy is 0 grade.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': 'The equator is at 0°'; the equator divides the globe into two equal halves (Humboldt State University GSP).

items.bewering: Van die ewenaar af tel jy tot by 90 grade noord by die Noordpool. Aan die ander kant lê 90 grade suid by die Suidpool.
items.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': both poles are at 90° from the equator, labelled N or S.

items.bewering: Kilometers sê hoe ver jy geloop het, en 'n graad sê iets anders. Sit jou vinger op die ewenaar en skuif hom tot by die Noordpool. So draai jou vinger 'n stukkie om die bal. 'n Graad meet daardie draai en sê hoe ver 'n plek van 'n nullyn af lê.
items.bron: Humboldt State University GSP, 'Latitude and Longitude': 'Both longitude and latitude are angles measured with the center of the earth as an origin.' Mapping checked: a finger moved over the surface from the equator to the pole sweeps a quarter turn (90°) about the centre, which is exactly what latitude measures; the contrast with kilometres is correct, since a degree is an angle, not a length. Nothing in the comparison leads a learner to a false conclusion.

items.bewering: Op 'n gradeboog staan die grade as klein merke langs die rand. Die merke tel die grade van 'n draai, en 'n volle draai is 360 grade.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Degree (angle)': a degree is a unit of plane angle in which one full rotation is 360 degrees; University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': the equatorial circle is divided into 360°. CAPS Gr 4-6 SW (KABV), p. 29, lists a '360° gradeboog' among the recommended resources for this topic, confirming the term.

items.bewering: Lengtegrade is die lyne wat van die een pool na die ander pool loop.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': meridians are imaginary half-circles running from the North Pole to the South Pole.

items.bewering: Die een by 0 grade loop deur Greenwich in Engeland. Ons noem daardie lyn die Greenwich Meridiaan, en ons tel van hom af.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': the 0° meridian (prime meridian) is drawn through Greenwich, England, and meridians are numbered east and west from it. The name 'Greenwich Meridiaan' is the term CAPS uses (KABV Gr 4-6 SW, p. 29: 'geskei deur die Greenwich Meridiaan en 180° lengtelyn').

items.bewering: Jy tel tot by 180 grade oos en tot by 180 grade wes.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': longitude is measured from 0° to 180°, and east and west longitude meet at the 180° meridian.

items.bewering: Naby die pole is die bal smaller en daarom word breedtegrade daar korter.
items.blok: Die verskil tussen die twee stelle lyne
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': 'the parallels decrease in size towards the poles'. The stated cause (the sphere narrows toward the poles) is the correct mechanism.

items.bewering: Lengtegrade doen iets anders, en hulle is almal ewe lank.
items.blok: Die verskil tussen die twee stelle lyne
items.bron: Absolute claim ('almal') checked as such. University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': 'all lines of longitude are the same length.'

items.bewering: Hulle staan wyd uitmekaar by die ewenaar en kom by die pole bymekaar. Volg twee lengtegrade met jou vingers, en hulle raak by 'n pool aan mekaar.
items.blok: Die verskil tussen die twee stelle lyne
items.bron: Ritter, 'The Physical Environment', 1.4.01 Latitude and Longitude (geo.libretexts.org; Ohio University open text): meridians are farthest apart at the equator and converge at the poles; CARIS Geomatics Reference Guide, 'Meridians and Parallels': meridians are spaced farthest apart at the equator and converge to common points at the poles.

items.bewering: Elke plek tussen die twee pole van die aardbol lê waar een breedtegraad en een lengtegraad kruis.
items.bron: Absolute claim ('elke') checked as such. University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': 'Any point on the globe can be located exactly by specifying its latitude and longitude.' Excluding the poles is correct, since all meridians meet there and a pole has no single longitude.

items.bewering: Die breedtegraad se getal sê hoe ver die plek noord of suid van die ewenaar lê. Die lengtegraad se getal sê hoe ver dit oos of wes van die Greenwich Meridiaan lê.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': parallels are described by degrees north or south of the equator; meridians by degrees east or west of the prime meridian.

items.bewering: Sonder noord of suid en sonder oos of wes kan dieselfde twee getalle op vier plekke pas. Met die rigting by elke getal wys die twee saam een plek. So kan jy ook 'n plek in die middel van die see aanwys.
items.bron: Follows from the N/S and E/W labelling described by University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe' (e.g. 30, 25 fits 30°N 25°E, 30°N 25°W, 30°S 25°E and 30°S 25°W). 'kan ... pas' is correctly hedged: on the equator, the Greenwich Meridian or the 180° line fewer than four places fit, and the sentence does not claim otherwise. The same source states any point can be located exactly with latitude and longitude, which covers the open sea.

items.bewering: aardbol: 'n Klein ronde model van die aarde wat jy kan draai.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Globe': a three-dimensional, ball-shaped scale model of Earth; Wikipedia, 'Globe': a spherical model of Earth (terrestrial globe), commonly mounted so that it can be turned.

items.bewering: breedtegraad: 'n Maat in grade wat sê hoe ver 'n plek noord of suid van die ewenaar lê. Op 'n kaart of 'n aardbol word dit as 'n lyn getrek wat ewewydig met die ewenaar om die aarde loop.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe' (latitude measured in degrees N or S of the equator; parallels are circles parallel to the equator); Dutch reference definitions via encyclo.nl/begrip/lengtegraad and related: breedtegraad is the angular distance to the equator.

items.bewering: lengtegraad: 'n Maat in grade wat sê hoe ver 'n plek oos of wes van die Greenwich Meridiaan lê. Op 'n kaart of 'n aardbol word dit as 'n lyn van pool tot pool getrek.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe' (longitude measured in degrees east or west of the prime meridian; meridians run from pole to pole); encyclo.nl, 'Lengtegraad': the angle between a place's meridian plane and that of the Greenwich prime meridian.

items.bewering: graad: 'n Eenheid wat 'n draai meet; dit wys hoe ver 'n plek om die aarde van die ewenaar of die Greenwich Meridiaan af lê.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Degree (angle)': unit of plane angle, full rotation = 360°; Humboldt State University GSP, 'Latitude and Longitude': latitude and longitude are angles measured from the centre of the earth.

items.bewering: ewenaar: Die breedtegraad van 0 grade om die middel van die aarde.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': the equator is at 0°; it divides the globe into two equal halves.

items.bewering: Greenwich Meridiaan: Die lengtegraad van 0 grade wat deur Greenwich in Engeland loop.
items.bron: University of Hawai'i, 'Locating points on a globe': the 0° (prime) meridian is drawn through Greenwich, England; adopted internationally in 1884 (webwoordenboek.nl / encyclo.nl, nulmeridiaan). Term as used in CAPS KABV Gr 4-6 SW, p. 29.

opsomming: Every claim in the lesson checks out against university and reference sources, including both comparisons (the Earth as a ball, and the finger's turn as what a degree measures); the lesson has no true superlatives, and its three absolute claims (parallels never touch, all meridians are equally long, every place between the poles lies where two lines cross) are all correct as worded.
